business_problem: Parloa saw a need for businesses to use AI for personalized, dynamic customer support experiences. Taking a “voice-first” approach, it wanted to create human-like interactions regardless of language.
solution_summary: Parloa used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Cognitive Services to support customer and agent interactions with AI-assisted automation. Parloa saw a need for businesses to use AI for personalized, dynamic customer support experiences. Taking a “voice-first” approach, it wanted to create human-like interactions regardless of language. Key implementation elements included Azure OpenAI Service generates natural-language responses and task automation for the solution; Azure AI Search retrieves enterprise content so answers stay grounded in customer data; Azure Cognitive Services adds speech, vision, or language capabilities required by the experience; Azure Kubernetes Service runs containerized application services at scale on Azure. Customer questions enter the assistant from web, voice, or messaging channels; the ai layer interprets intent and generates responses or actions; answers or next steps are returned to customers, agents, or clinicians through the front-end...

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service

solution_components.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365

solution_components.name: Azure Cosmos DB
solution_components.role: Stores application state and knowledge or interaction data.

data_flow: Customer questions enter the assistant from web, voice, or messaging channels; the ai layer interprets intent and generates responses or actions; answers or next steps are returned to customers, agents, or clinicians through the front-end experience.
business_outcome: Call center agents are empowered to answer calls faster and with greater accuracy. Customers are seeing increased sales and customer satisfaction.
